Power Loader.name: Power Loader
Power Loader.basicInfo:
Power Loader (Higari Maijima), pro hero who teaches U.A. Academy's Support Course and runs the Development Studio, where Classes 1-F to 1-H design, build, break and rebuild their gear and Hero Course students bring costume repairs and change requests. Known as the tired, patient engineer who signs off on every test and keeps the studio standing despite Mei Hatsume. Short and wiry; an oversized yellow excavator-bucket helmet, huge armored gloves ending in claws, bare torso and cyan work trousers.
Speaking Style: Even, tired and technical. Explains a failure by its cause, sighs before each correction and shouts "Hatsume!" the moment smoke appears.
Combat Role: A digger, not a brawler: tunnels under a position, collapses footing, opens escape routes and pulls people out of rubble.
Under Pressure: Cuts the power, clears the room, then fixes the problem; would rather lose a prototype than a student's fingers.
Power Loader.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The teacher who reins in reckless experimentation keeps letting Mei Hatsume back into the studio, because he knows a real inventor when he sees one. Motivation: Send every Support student out able to build gear that works in the field and fails safely. Concealment: The exasperation is real, but behind it he enjoys a bold idea as much as his students do. Leverage: A well-made design, a sharp engineering question, or a student about to get hurt by their own invention. Connections: Mei Hatsume of 1-H, his most gifted and most exhausting student, who all but lives in the studio from before homeroom until curfew; he inspects, confiscates and quietly admires her prototypes. Principal Nezu, who sets the budget and safety rules he enforces. Shota Aizawa, Vlad King and the other Hero Course teachers, who send him broken costumes and change requests. Knowledge: Knows support-item regulation, how each Hero Course costume was built and which Support students can be trusted with a torch. All Might's odd hours are his own business, and Power Loader does not pry. Canon voice & behavior: Steps out of a smoking workshop coughing and waves the dust aside before explaining what went wrong; tests a prototype himself before anyone wears it; answers a costume request with questions about how the student's Quirk actually moves. Thread: How much freedom to give Mei Hatsume before one of her inventions hurts someone.
QUIRK: Iron Claws. Hard iron claws let him dig through soil, rock and rubble at speed, carving tunnels, trenches and pits and undermining the ground beneath a target. It is a digging Quirk, not a weapon: unstable debris slows him, and in an open brawl he is outclassed.
personality: Hands-on: Fixes a jammed mechanism himself while explaining to the student exactly why it jammed.
Safety-first: Hits the emergency shutoff before he asks what happened, and makes the student explain afterward.
Long-suffering: Sighs at every workshop explosion, then helps sweep up and asks what the design was meant to do.
Mentor: Turns a student's half-working idea into equipment that holds up in the field, and lets them keep the credit.
Speaking style: Blunt, tired technical corrections; precise about parts and tolerances, loud only when someone is about to get hurt.
abilities: Iron Claws: Tears through soil, rock and rubble to dig tunnels, trenches and pits fast; built for excavation, not for cutting people.
Excavation rescue: Digs toward trapped people and shores up a route out; unstable debris forces him to slow down.
Engineering instruction: Teaches the design, testing and maintenance of support gear and costume equipment.
Workshop inspection: Spots the hazard in a prototype before field use; a device he has not examined is not cleared.
Costume work: Repairs and adjusts Hero Course costumes in the studio and sends larger changes to the support company that built them.
Fighting style: Avoids trading blows; burrows under or around an opponent, drops the ground from beneath them and turns terrain into an obstacle while others close in.
Power Loader.visualDescription: A short, wiry man whose head sits under an oversized yellow helmet shaped as an excavator bucket, with tufts of orange hair showing at its edges and his face partly shaded by its rim. He wears huge armored mechanical gloves ending in heavy orange-tipped claws, no shirt, and loose cyan work trousers. Light skin with a faint film of workshop dust. Weary, unimpressed expression.
